defensive_gaps.missing_port_or_channel_after_validated_: Safe Clack iterators preserve counts for live host-backed memory; absence after count1/2 is defensive.

defensive_gaps.paired_service_failure_after_load: Only controller-matched endpoint can occupy primary parked slot; public foreign-pair core law remains independently tested, adapter cannot manufacture such pair.
